messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['As the Primary Contact, you must renew the service (s) listed below: SERVICE: Online Banking and Access services.', 'Join Our lottery service today and get a free lottery ticket.', 'To prevent an interruption with your AOL services, please take a few moments to update your Credit Card account information today.', 'You can choose your payment method and, if you wish, cancel your Billing Agreement in the "My pre-approved payments" section, only after you complete all the spaces.', 'SILVER PLAN $60 SEND 500K EMAILS PER DAY FOR ONE-MONTH']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
